---
title: "Week 3 - Data Wrangling"
subtitle: "June 1 - 5, 2026"
---

We cover the dplyr verbs `filter`, `select`, `mutate`, `arrange`, `group_by`, `summarize`, plus `pivot_longer` and `pivot_wider`. By Friday you should be able to take a messy CSV and produce useful summaries. Friday also introduces Git/GitHub, in time to use it for your project teamwork.
